result.detail: Decisions recorded: (1) The holding registers aw_addr_q, w_data_q and w_strb_q are not reset, as microarchitecture section 2 specifies. Their contents are used only while the reset-cleared held flags are set. (2) A read and a write to the same register on the same edge return the pre-write value. This follows from microarchitecture sections 2 and 5, and the testbench model encodes it. (3) No formal_spec (.sby) file is submitted, because the expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only. As a result, req:AXIL-FORMAL from interface_spec section 8 remains open for whoever owns the proof task. The properties are already in the RTL under ifdef FORMAL, ready for a single-task .sby with mode prove. (4) Both files carry `timescale 1ns/1ps, so Verilator does not raise TIMESCALEMOD. Under Verilator, the default error limit means the first $error ends the run, which is still a failed run.
